title: BIM Clash Prioritisation

engineFeatures.meaning: the feature that best separates the classes
the feature on which classes 2 and 3 barely differ
the repeat entity that must not appear on both sides of a split

label: For "BIM Clash Prioritisation": Rank model clashes between disciplines by real impact and likely fix owner so coordination meetings resolve the important ones first and ignore harmless overlaps. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Overlap volume as severity.
